title: Make answer
description: The answer of the command make, on standard output: the vendor's id of the machine the adapter made for the request's key. One key makes at most one machine, so a second make with the same key has the id of the machine that the first make with that key made. The answer is at most 1 MiB. It has no version. A member this schema does not define is refused.

id.description: A machine's id at the vendor, as the vendor writes it: 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters with no space, and never exactly -.
The vendor's id of the machine the adapter made.
